app_tagline: A mood-based social app for anonymous chat, matching, and shared activities.
app_description: Six daily activities. Anonymous. Resets every 24 hours.
age_error: You must be 16 or older to join Aura.
fill_required: Please enter your age and choose a gender.
signin_failed: Could not sign you in. Please try again.
privacy_note: No email, no phone, no name. Just presence — and only what you choose to share.
six_activities: Six daily activities. Anonymous. Resets every 24 hours.
privacy_footer: Everything disappears after 24 hours. No profiles, no history, just presence.
mood_chat_desc: Anonymous group chat for people feeling the same mood right now.
match_finder_desc: Anonymous pairing — match first, profiles unlock after both agree.
daily_question_desc: A short prompt each day. Share an answer and read anonymous replies.
skill_swap_desc: Teach a skill, learn a skill. Chat first, video only if both accept.
event_buddy_desc: Find someone to join an event with — concerts, dinners, walks.
collab_studio_desc: Draw together on a live canvas. See each other’s cursors in real-time.
feeling_now: How are you feeling right now?
pick_a_mood: Pick a mood to enter the room
no_messages: No messages yet. Be the first to say hi.
i_want_to_learn: I want to learn… (Spanish, drawing, marketing)
swap_pending: Pending — waiting for them to accept
video_pending: Video call requested — waiting for them
event_location_ph: e.g. Central Park, the coffee shop downtown
empty_no_messages: No messages yet. Say hi to get started.
empty_no_matches: No one’s here yet — post a card to be first.
empty_no_swaps: No swaps yet. Be the first to post.
display_name_ph: e.g. Alex — only shown once you match
match_identity_hint: Your name and photo stay hidden until you both match — everything else on this card is public.
draw_and_chat: Draw together, chat live — both update in real-time.
report_details_ph: Add any details that would help (optional)
report_submitted: Thanks — we've received your report and will look into it.
you_blocked_this_person: You've blocked this person. Unblock them from the safety menu to see this chat again.
offline_banner: You're offline — messages won't send until you're back online.
admin_not_authorized: You don't have access to this page.
presence_unavailable: Live count unavailable right now — this doesn't affect chatting.
push_optin_desc: Turn on notifications so you'll know the moment someone requests to match, swap, or join your event — even when Aura isn't open.
wants_to_swap_you: Wants to swap skills with you.
onboarding_welcome_desc: No profiles, no history that follows you around — just six ways to talk to someone right now. Here's a quick look at each one.
onboarding_safety_desc: You can block or report anyone, anywhere in the app, from the ⋮ menu next to their name. Blocking hides them everywhere instantly.
your_profile_hint: Your age, sex, hobbies, bio and what you're looking for are shown on your public card. Your name and photo stay hidden until you match with someone.
no_matches_yet: No matches yet — request a match above to start a conversation.
no_swaps_yet: No swaps yet — request a swap above to start a conversation.
match_request_accepted: Someone accepted your match request — you can chat now!
swap_request_accepted: Someone accepted your swap request — you can chat now!
event_join_accepted: The host accepted your request to join — you can chat now!
video_call_requested_notify: Someone wants a video call with you.
video_call_accepted_notify: Your video call request was accepted — you can start the call!
save_profile_before_matching: Save your profile above (name, age, sex and photo) before requesting or accepting a match — so the other person has your profile to see too.
